recipe.visualDefinition: A sepia-toned, mixed-media illustration featuring a large profile sketch of a man's face integrated with surreal elements including a rollercoaster track emerging from his ear and a whimsical, anthropomorphic frog character in formal attire. The style mimics a stained sketchbook page with ink splatters and rough hatching.
coreVisualRelationships: The rollercoaster track acts as a bridge between the human profile and the frog character.
The typography follows the upward curve of the rollercoaster track.
The warm sepia wash unifies the disparate sketch elements into a single cohesive scene.
coreInvariants: Heavy use of cross-hatching for shading.
Organic, hand-drawn line quality with varying weights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large human profile occupies the upper left; small character and track occupy the center and lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, closed-eye human face in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the track downward to the frog, then curves back up through the text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space on the left and bottom, filled with watercolor textures and light ink splatters.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre washes for the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black ink for outlines and deep shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle hints of muted red in the ear area.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the ink lines and the light paper background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Victorian circus and woodblock display types.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, slab-like serifs with internal decorative patterns.
Letters are warped to follow a curved, ribbon-like path.
Heavy 3D extrusion or drop shadows to create depth.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and more ornate.
Internal hatching mimics the shading of the illustration.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata to contrast the heavy decorative display type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, slightly distressed Victorian vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned ink sketch on stained parchment. Feature a large profile of a man's face on the left, with a rollercoaster track emerging from his ear and leading to a small, dressed-up frog character holding a cane in the center. Use cross-hatching and ink washes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom Victorian-style decorative lettering in the upper right, following the curve of the rollercoaster track. Use heavy slab serifs with internal hatching and 3D depth.

verificationChecks: Does the text follow the curve of the track?
Is the shading achieved through hatching rather than smooth gradients?
Does the background look like aged, stained paper?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the man
Unique character design of the frog
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present.
Check that the ink splatters look organic and random.
Verify the 3D extrusion of the text matches the perspective of the scene.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale human sketch with a small-scale surreal narrative element, unified by a single-color ink wash and curved, decorative display typography.
